title: CIA sends Mooney's Cherokee book and asks about Native American DNA

tellings.quote: a book showed up to my house that uh was sent from some folks in the government CIA and said, "Read this."

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had UFO encounters, says that some people from the CIA, the US spy agency, sent a book to his home and told him, "Read this." The book was Myths of the Cherokee, written by James Mooney in 1891, and Bledsoe says they also asked him about Native American DNA, which he takes to mean they thought his family background was tied to his experiences.
